# P1 — полная статическая консолидация current review decisions

Навигация: [P0](P0.md) · [P1](P1.md) · [P2](P2.md) · [input inventory](P0.md#input-inventory) · [source plans](#original-plan-items).

## Методика и проверенный срез

Это консолидация **всех 189 входных Markdown**, а не исправление кода и не новый exhaustive audit всего repository. Все входные тексты прочитаны целиком (включая тематические отчёты, engine TASK_GROUPS, root SUMMARY/CRATE_PRIORITY и collapsed history): **84777 строк**, **7740601 Unicode characters**. История использована для происхождения, механизма и исходных планов; действующие решения — authoritative prefix до первого `<details>`. Исторические повторы вторично не подсчитываются. Прежние verdicts были гипотезами: проверены current implementation, callers, контракты, existing oracle assertions и registrations, а не только summary labels.

Входные обзоры привязаны к frozen source `e3765c935fc71655ee1ec0160cf180607935d89b`; HEAD при старте — `66c19fe452c16cb587c8a3b7863ae63b0c07e15a`. Здесь source evidence относится **к доступному изменённому working tree**, не выдаётся за тот frozen snapshot. Полностью прочитаны 820 обнаруженных source/contract/config/test текстов (280466 строк); frozen git objects использованы для remap line numbers и различения внешних diff. До запуска уже существовали 28 tracked modifications и один untracked history-overlay test; они не принадлежат этому обзору и оставлены нетронутыми. SequenceMatcher сопоставляет frozen references с фактически прочитанными current строками; номера в source links — current. Ссылки на исходные review anchors сохраняют frozen происхождение allegation, не подменяют current доказательство.

Срез не атомарный: последовательные чтения, normalized UTF-8/LF text fingerprints и повторная static consistency сверка. Промежуточная сверка не обнаружила изменения прочитанных 189 inputs или 820 source texts; post-write static check результат отдельно передаётся вместе с handoff; этот текст фиксирует срез до создания файлов. Это не commit/deployment/installed-toolchain snapshot и не гарантия отсутствия изменений в непрочитанных файлах.

**Ничего не запускалось:** компилятор, cargo, сборка, clippy, formatter, tests, benchmarks, проект или воспроизведения. Выполнялись только чтение, read-only git diff/show, получение primary source texts и обработка уже прочитанных данных в памяти. Другие агенты не запускались. Единственные записи в repository — новые `P0.md`, `P1.md`, `P2.md`. Наличие test файла, manifest registration, старого green label, same-helper roundtrip или bare `is_err` не считается выполненной или достаточной проверкой.

### Правила группировки и verdict

Исходный P — **приоритет plan item, не severity**. Сохранены все 423 явно P-размеченных пункта: P0=87, P1=183, P2=153. Ещё 24 `shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md` Plan 1–24 восстановлены по настоящим historical P headers: 1–4→P0, 5–15→P1, 16–24→P2. Итого **P0=91, P1=194, P2=162; 447** исходных plan decisions. ID не переименованы. Каждый plan table находится на собственном исходном P, даже когда его mechanism canon расположен в более срочном файле. Shared plan не означает shared cause: составные планы и 19 engine TASK bundles направлены к отдельным leaves. Same cause по guarantee/trigger/caller из нескольких линз/crates имеет одну карточку; происхождение и scoped verdict каждой строки сохранены отдельно. Mixed `refuted/open` в одном canon означает разные формулировки/границы, не автоматическое превращение опровергнутой строки в баг.

NEW и текущие claims без P привязаны к соответствующему существующему механизму/плану; иначе самостоятельная P-классификация явно объяснена. Только для таких неразмеченных пунктов: P0 — срочные подтверждённые integrity/security/availability transitions; P1 — другая корректность/конкурентность/контракты и существенные unverified boundaries; P2 — scoped costs/coverage/docs/style без установленного серьёзного runtime harm. Исторический P0 у style/perf/testing задачи не заменён на P2. Risk, reachability и status — отдельные поля.

`confirmed-open` — source-backed текущий механизм/обязанность в указанном scope; `partially-fixed` — конкретная часть снята, остаток указан; `fixed` — названный original mechanism source-fixed, не passing-tests/release certificate; `refuted` — есть положительное counter-evidence; `not-applicable` — intentional policy/ownership/legacy/API redesign либо calibration non-finding без нарушенного обязательства; `unverified` — названа недостающая premise, **не safe**. Costs — структурные выводы, не измеренные latency/RSS/throughput/численные выигрыши. Public-library, privileged embedding, authenticated wire, source-compilation permission и locally corrupted persisted state различаются.

### Exact dependency/contract дисциплина

Current `Cargo.lock`/manifest slice: **Wasmtime 48.0.5** (входные reports проверяли 46.0.2), **rustls 0.23.45** (в reports 0.23.37), declared Rust **1.95.0** (не установленная/исполненная версия). Проверены соответствующие changed-pin ветки `validate_sync_call`, imported async requirements, `func_wrap_async`, provider auto-selection; tagged Rust 1.95 source подтверждает Vec initialization, numeric Hash dispatch, PartialEq law, token prefix copying и unbuffered Condvar notification. Обновление pins само по себе не закрывает getter/reentry, alias или lifecycle defects. В процитированных входных paragraphs старые версии — frozen provenance; current conclusions используют эту перепроверку.

Checksum SHA-256 **54** доступных published `.crate` archives совпал с current lockfile; inspected exact member texts — **79**, без extraction на диск. Среди load-bearing pins: Fjall/lsm-tree 3.1.6, Tokio 1.49.0, scc 3.8.4, rmp-serde 1.3.1, serde/serde_core 1.0.228, indexmap 2.14.0, libc 0.2.186, bincode 1.3.3, peak_alloc 0.3.0. NAPI 3.10.5 source проверен против exact manifest pin через published source; Node исключён из workspace, отдельно resolved transitive/build/native artifact граф не сертифицирован. Доступный installed `@msgpack/msgpack` 3.1.3 разрешён binding range `^3.0.0`, но это не universal npm-resolution guarantee. Curl parser evidence условно относится к 8.10.1-compatible config/resolve grammar; установленный curl не запускался и не идентифицирован. AArch64 alignment premise для vld1_lane_u32 разрешена по exact 1.95 generated source (typed *ptr); остальные target stack margins, deep macro parse/render/drop limits, quantitative HashDoS/compile/perf и out-of-tree consumers не объявлены доказанными.

Reference guarantees: alpha no-in-place-upgrade policy [README:33](../../../../README.md)/[CHANGELOG:13](../../../../CHANGELOG.md); scoped [SECURITY](../../../../SECURITY.md); [house rules](../../../../CLAUDE.md); storage durability/atomicity [Store contract:211–285](../../../../crates/shamir-storage/src/types.rs); actual test selection [runner:126–181](../../../../scripts/test.sh). Строгие wire/spec/identity обещания сверены с protocol docs и exact sources, а не выведены из успешной симметричной serialization.

Guidance здесь оставлено только для конкретно названного механизма/qualified plan. Пустое recipe/oracle поле не заполняется общим шаблоном. Cargo.lock/manifest citations означают provenance, а не callable seam; test-source citation сама по себе не доказывает регистрацию, target selection или покрытие данного consumer. Конкретные assertions, caller/registry facts и ограничения остаются в source/trigger/counter sections и plan ledger.

Canonical input decision cards: **358** = active/partial/unverified **312** + closed/calibration **46**. These are deduplicated mechanisms/guarantee obligations plus explicitly named non-findings, **не число уникальных runtime bugs**. ## Новая xxs source карточка вне input ledger

<a id="xxs-tx-shared-timestamp"></a>

### XXS-NEW-TX-TIMESTAMP — per-key vacuum removes a still-used shared commit timestamp

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium` temporal correctness/metadata retention; **P:** **P1**, tied to corresponding timestamp/vacuum correctness [shamir-tx/SUMMARY.md · Plan P1.8](shamir-tx/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-8), separate from performance P0.5 and P2.21. **Модули:** shamir-tx; engine callers as source context. **Input observation ID:** отсутствует — новое xxs observation, не добавлено к 94/3176 input count.

- **Invariant:** version-scoped ts_key/index survives while another retained/current key in **the same MvccStore/table** still references that version. Per-key data deletion не означает, что shared commit version полностью retired from that history.
- **Exact trigger/conditions:** одна multi-key commit V пишет A и B в одной table; history persistence completed, normal overlay/pending stamp GC at V. B остаётся current@V. При CurrentOnly/no-snapshot policy два последующих direct Table/Mvcc updates только A сначала defer V, потом fast vacuum removes A@V **и global ts_key(V)/ts_index(V)**. B@V data остаётся current/retained, но history_of(B).ts_millis становится None; timestamp-major as-of lookup может потерять единственную qualifying V. Scan retention branch также удаляет version stamp на per-key candidate basis. No corruption, backward clock или variable-key overlap нужно. **Exact stock-wire route до direct setter в этом обзоре не заявляется**: public MvccStore и actor-less Table paths подтверждены, normal multi-key commit source поддержан.
- **Counter-evidence:** version timestamps намеренно keyed только V, не key; absent pre-T1c stamps legitimate unknown age и сохраняются консервативно. Pending stamp/overlay может временно скрыть deletion, но после completed persistence/normal GC его уже нет. Разные tables имеют отдельные history stores — этот witness требует именно same-table multi-key V, не один V в двух таблицах. Current record bytes B не объявлены потерянными этой карточкой.
- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mod.rs:70](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mod.rs) (global ts key), [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs:342](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs)–[crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs:382](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs) (several data ops/share v + one ts), [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_gc.rs:100](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_gc.rs)–[crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_gc.rs:113](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_gc.rs), [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_gc.rs:246](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_gc.rs)–[crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_gc.rs:249](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_gc.rs), [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mod.rs:310](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mod.rs), [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs:223](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs), [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs:74](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs), [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mod.rs:830](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mod.rs).
- **Already fixed / remains:** inline/direct writes correctly stamp and mark durable, overlay-first history merge уже source-fixed внешне. Их correctness предполагает, что timestamp ownership не разрушено чужим per-key vacuum. Нынешний deletion не считает оставшиеся same-store key references V.
- **Safe direction:** retain shared timestamp/index until no retained history/current reference needs V, либо другой доказанный version-level lifecycle; coordinate durable/overlay/replay and timestamp index, не только оставить один in-memory map item. Exact-orig key selection alone не исправляет этот distinct cause; no unconditional change to version-at-time definition.
- **Future oracle:** real same-table two-key transaction at independently known T, completed persistence + overlay/stamp GC, two A updates at later times; B current bytes и history timestamp T сохраняются, and as-of target=T resolves promised V. Repeat count-scan policy plus restart; single-key monotone-timestamp fixture не различает shared ownership. Mutation deleting ts_key(V) on A-only reclaim должен изменить assertions. Никаких tests/reproductions не исполнено.
- **Existing oracle scope:** registered timestamp-index/history/retention tests на monotone/independent version fixtures не устанавливают shared-V current-B stamp preservation; наличие timestamp-scan oracle не защищает deleted input stamp.
- **Dependencies:** [XXS-NEW-TX-PREFIX](P2.md#xxs-tx-prefix-vacuum) (independent neighbour-data selection); [RV-TX-B40374FD](#rv-tx-b40374fd) (independent timestamp/version-order law); [RV-TX-3B9F4D3B](P2.md#rv-tx-3b9f4d3b) (remaining timestamp lookup cost, не correctness fix).

### RV-BENCH-UTILS-C5422902 — `peak_mem`'s measurement window is unowned: concurrent or aborted use silently corrupts the one process-global peak watermark

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-bench-utils`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-bench-utils/SUMMARY.md · Claim 2.1](shamir-bench-utils/SUMMARY.md#review-2-1); [shamir-bench-utils/api-wire-protocol.md · Claim 9](shamir-bench-utils/api-wire-protocol.md#review-9); [shamir-bench-utils/concurrency-lockfree.md · Claim 1](shamir-bench-utils/concurrency-lockfree.md#review-1); [shamir-bench-utils/concurrency-lockfree.md · Claim 2](shamir-bench-utils/concurrency-lockfree.md#review-2); [shamir-bench-utils/concurrency-lockfree.md · Claim 3](shamir-bench-utils/concurrency-lockfree.md#review-3); [shamir-bench-utils/error-handling-lifecycle.md · Claim 3](shamir-bench-utils/error-handling-lifecycle.md#review-3); [shamir-bench-utils/performance-hotpath.md · Claim 2](shamir-bench-utils/performance-hotpath.md#review-2).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-bench-utils P1.4 (P1)](shamir-bench-utils/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-4).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** An outer measurement can allocate and free its maximum before an inner measurement resets it. Separately, published peak_alloc 0.3.0 src/lib.rs:108–109 and :125–127 permit reset-load, allocation-update, stale-reset-store, leaving peak below live allocation. Source: https://docs.rs/crate/peak_alloc/0.3.0/source/src/lib.rs. Subsequent-helper cancellation inheritance is refuted; current raw samples are sequential.

- **Qualified direction:** Один process-global measurement window требует exclusive scoped ownership либо явно документированной unsupported concurrent/nested measurement policy. Reset и peak capture должны принадлежать одному window и иметь согласованный порядок с allocation updates; byte/count budgets не исправляют stale-reset-store или потерю outer peak.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs:89](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs:106](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/benches/streaming_topk.rs:143](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/benches/streaming_topk.rs); [Cargo.lock:2396](../../../../Cargo.lock); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs:48](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs:74](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs:57](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs); [crates/shamir-index/benches/create_index_streaming.rs:211](../../../../crates/shamir-index/benches/create_index_streaming.rs); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs:71](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs:98](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/peak_mem.rs).

### RV-CLIENT-NODE-105A725D — One `tokio::sync::Mutex` held across every request serializes the demultiplexed client

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-client-node`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md · Claim 2.1](shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md#review-2-1).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Every request retains the exclusive binding guard through its core await, so a second call cannot register/send while the first awaits a response. This defeats the core's documented concurrent-call semantics. A controlled peer observing two requests before releasing either response discriminates this mechanism; existing sequential CRUD does not.

### RV-CLIENT-NODE-F90A248F — Concurrent JS callers see stale pin/ticket snapshots only (correct), but `close()`'s take-then-await ordering can strand in-flight callers behind a permanent lock (see 4.1/6.1)

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-client-node`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md · Claim 2.2](shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md#review-2-2); [shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md · Claim 4.1](shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md#review-4-1); [shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md · Claim 6.1](shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md#review-6-1).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-client-node P1.5 (P1)](shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-5).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Getter snapshots are immutable and independent of the request mutex. However, an unanswered request holds that mutex indefinitely and close cannot acquire it. Close also retains its own guard during shutdown. The useful oracle is close plus pending-call settlement after a peer receives but withholds a response, not a sleep-based timing assertion.

- **Дополнительные counter-evidence / границы:** Close is idempotent after completion, but cannot interrupt an unanswered request holding the same mutex.

<a id="rv-client-node-067017c8"></a>

### RV-CLIENT-NODE-067017C8 — Caller-owned Buffer aliases are read on async workers without mutation isolation

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `high`; **тип:** memory/ownership safety — scoped reachability. **Модули:** `shamir-client-node`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.1](shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-1).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-client-node P1.7 (P1)](shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-7).

- **Нарушенный invariant / проверяемая обязанность:** JS-мутируемый Buffer не читается на worker по алиасу без синхронного ownership snapshot.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Public repl forwards the caller's Buffer unchanged; connect also retains the caller's trustedPin Buffer. Generated async dispatch runs Rust reading/copying of these bytes on a Tokio worker. Exact napi 3.10.5 FromNapiValue obtains the original JS pointer and holds only a lifetime reference; its Send comment explicitly acknowledges unsynchronized JS mutation as undefined behavior. Ordinary JS can reuse or overwrite the buffer while the worker reads it. This is a local API ownership/safety witness, not proof of remote exploitability or observed crashing. Snapshot ownership must be established synchronously before off-thread dispatch; copying only inside the worker still races. Published source: https://docs.rs/crate/napi/3.10.5/source/src/bindgen_runtime/js_values/buffer.rs.

- **Что source-fixed и что остаётся:** napi 3.10.5 FromNapiValue сохраняет JS pointer и lifetime ref, не mutation isolation; unsafe Send/Sync comments сами называют эту alias проблему.

- **Safe direction (без реализации):** Скопировать/преобразовать Buffer в owned immutable input на JS callback до создания off-thread future; copy внутри async Rust body всё ещё races.

- **Различающий future oracle (не написан и не запускался):** Caller изменяет исходный Buffer после синхронного handoff и до контролируемого worker read; native операция читает только первоначальный snapshot. Проверить repl и trustedPin отдельно без попытки UB reproduction.

### RV-CLIENT-F91F11CE — Orphaned `pending` entries when the caller's future is cancelled (no drop guard)

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-client`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-client/SUMMARY.md · Claim 4.4](shamir-client/SUMMARY.md#review-4-4); [shamir-client/error-handling-lifecycle.md · Claim 8](shamir-client/error-handling-lifecycle.md#review-8); [shamir-client/performance-hotpath.md · Claim 4](shamir-client/performance-hotpath.md#review-4).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-client P1.9 (P1)](shamir-client/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-9).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Dropping the future after registration bypasses explicit write-error and local response-timeout cleanup. Against unanswered requests, entries persist for the connection lifetime. Removing them alone does not solve partially cancelled writes.

### RV-CLIENT-3594376F — Sparse touch responses advance the client's completeness epoch past missing IDs

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-client`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-client/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.3](shamir-client/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-3).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-client P1.7 (P1)](shamir-client/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-7).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** With a fresh Client and an existing repository dictionary containing IDs 1..3, touch_fields of only the name at ID 3 merges that one mapping and advances epoch to at least 3. InternerTouch is an admin op, so distinct_repos does not request an ambient delta. refresh_repo and subsequent automatic sync ask for IDs greater than 3, never recovering missing IDs 1 and 2; an id-keyed read using them can fail despite refresh. No hostile peer or concurrency is required. The discriminating oracle is a fresh client touching one high existing ID, then refreshing and reading a row containing a lower untouched ID. Retain a completeness watermark separate from sparse observed mappings.

<a id="rv-client-764d86d0"></a>

### RV-CLIENT-764D86D0 — Cancelling a partially written roundtrip leaves a live connection with corrupted frame alignment

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-client`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-client/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.4](shamir-client/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-4).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-client P1.9 (P1)](shamir-client/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-9).

- **Нарушенный invariant / проверяемая обязанность:** Cancellation после частичного frame write не оставляет reusable connection с потерянным framing progress.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** roundtrip holds the write mutex while write_frame awaits Tokio write_all. Exact Tokio 1.49.0 write_all may accept a prefix, advance its private buffer slice, then return Pending. External cancellation drops that progress and releases the mutex without closing or marking the Client unusable. The next request starts a new length prefix inside the unfinished previous frame, corrupting server framing. This is reachable with ordinary socket backpressure and an outer timeout/task cancellation; request_timeout does not cover writing. A pending-map RAII guard alone cannot fix it. The oracle must cancel after a controlled real framing prefix write, then verify either completion of that frame or explicit connection failure before another send. Source: https://docs.rs/crate/tokio/1.49.0/source/src/io/util/write_all.rs

- **Что source-fixed и что остаётся:** write mutex drop освобождает admission, Tokio write_all private remainder теряется; request_timeout начинает ждать лишь после write.

- **Safe direction (без реализации):** Владеть завершением всего frame в writer task либо терминально fail/close при отмене; pending-map Drop guard сам не исправляет byte stream alignment.

- **Различающий future oracle (не написан и не запускался):** Контролируемый writer принимает prefix, затем Pending; отменить outer roundtrip и вызвать следующий request. Разрешены только завершение старого frame или явный terminal failure до нового prefix.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-client/src/client.rs:1277](../../../../crates/shamir-client/src/client.rs); [crates/shamir-client/src/client.rs:1278](../../../../crates/shamir-client/src/client.rs); [crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/framing.rs:160](../../../../crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/framing.rs); [crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/framing.rs:163](../../../../crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/framing.rs); [Cargo.lock:4195](../../../../Cargo.lock).

<a id="rv-client-98656aaa"></a>

### RV-CLIENT-98656AAA — Opaque IdBytes map counts trigger uncapped allocation before body validation

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `high`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-client`, `shamir-collections`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-client/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.5](shamir-client/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-5); [shamir-collections/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.1](shamir-collections/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-1).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1, P2. Исходные пункты: [shamir-client P2.20 (P2)](shamir-client/SUMMARY.md#plan-p2-20); [shamir-collections P1.6 (P1)](shamir-collections/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-6).

- **Нарушенный invariant / проверяемая обязанность:** Header-only opaque IdBytes не авторизует count-proportional capacity до проверки body/явного бюджета.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** A v2 smart-path response can contain an opaque binary row consisting of a Map32 header with an attacker-chosen large count and no entries. Outer rmp-serde accepts the binary payload without interpreting its count. RecordView::new validates only the header; record_view_deintern_with immediately passes view.len to new_map_wc. Exact indexmap 2.14.0 with_capacity_and_hasher calls Core::with_capacity, reserving its hash index and Vec for that count before any body traversal. Thus a tiny in-cap frame can request extremely large allocation or encounter allocation/capacity failure outside ClientError. This requires a faulty/hostile authenticated or resume-substituted peer and a consumer using execute_with_touch, not ordinary Node execute or replication pull. No allocation/crash threshold was measured. Reject implausible cardinality against available bytes and an explicit budget before allocation. Source: https://docs.rs/crate/indexmap/2.14.0/source/src/inner.rs

- **Дополнительные counter-evidence / границы:** A complete five-byte Map32 header declaring u32::MAX entries with no body passes RecordView::new, which only validates the header. Only a normal-record index parity test is registered for this seam; garbage tests do not call index. No production caller was found, so remote severity is not asserted. The follow-up oracle should establish bounded initial reservation for a header-only input without attempting destructive OOM reproduction.

- **Что source-fixed и что остаётся:** Outer decoder guarded, host ValueVisitor clamp есть; RecordView consumers продолжают доверять n_entries без полного body validation. Public index без production caller отдельно квалифицирован.

- **Safe direction (без реализации):** Ограничить declared cardinality относительно bytes и квоты до new_map_wc/RecordView::index; выбрать fallible traversal/reservation. Один outer MessagePack frame cap не интерпретирует Bin body.

- **Различающий future oracle (не написан и не запускался):** Tiny Map32 header u32::MAX без body должен ограниченно отвергаться ДО большой reservation; counting/guarded allocator seam вместо destructive OOM. Проверить оба consumers: client de-intern и public index.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_record.rs:88](../../../../crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_record.rs); [crates/shamir-client/src/interner_cache_ops.rs:724](../../../../crates/shamir-client/src/interner_cache_ops.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs:158](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs:767](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/codecs/interned/codec.rs:227](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/codecs/interned/codec.rs); [crates/shamir-collections/src/lib.rs:29](../../../../crates/shamir-collections/src/lib.rs); [Cargo.lock:1782](../../../../Cargo.lock); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/mod.rs:42](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/mod.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs:1062](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/tests/parity_tests.rs:491](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/tests/parity_tests.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/tests/error_tests.rs:137](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/tests/error_tests.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/tests/mod.rs:5](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/tests/mod.rs).

### RV-COLLECTIONS-A5293F80 — Infallible capacity constructors can only abort the process; no fallible counterpart exists

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-collections`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-collections/SUMMARY.md · Claim 6.1](shamir-collections/SUMMARY.md#review-6-1); [shamir-collections/error-handling-lifecycle.md · Claim 1](shamir-collections/error-handling-lifecycle.md#review-1).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** The corrected current claim remains: helpers are infallible and undocumented. Its literal only-abort title is false because hashbrown 0.17.1 panics on capacity overflow. A raw Map32 header reaches new_map_wc before entries are read, contradicting the historical trusted-capacity assurance. Missing try helpers alone is an API choice; accepting unchecked declared counts is the caller hazard. Source: https://docs.rs/crate/hashbrown/0.17.1/source/src/raw.rs.

- **Дополнительные counter-evidence / границы:** Infallible undocumented allocation remains, but only-abort is false for overflow.

### RV-CONNECT-B11F48CA — ResumeConfig public key mutation leaves permanent cipher caches bound to old keys

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-connect`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-connect/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.3](shamir-connect/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-3).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Прямого явного plan item для собственного root нет; это распределение текущего не-P решения, а не новая исходная маркировка.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** After ciphers() initializes its OnceLocks, a caller with mutable ResumeConfig can change ticket_key or ticket_key_previous without invalidating either cache. A supposedly revoked old key continues decrypting, while issuance via the new raw key disagrees with cached resume encryption/decryption. Existing rotation tests mutate before first cache use and miss this lifecycle. Shipped configuration is constructed into an immutable shared Arc; no live key mutation was found. The discriminating oracle must warm the caches before changing/removing a key.

### RV-CONNECT-7DBC7BDB — Audit HMAC implementation omits the extra prev_hmac prefix required by its published formula

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-connect`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-connect/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.5](shamir-connect/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-5).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Прямого явного plan item для собственного root нет; это распределение текущего не-P решения, а не новая исходная маркировка.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Both the module formula and normative implementation guide define HMAC over prev_hmac followed by canonical(entry), while canonical(entry) itself ends with prev_hmac. compute_entry_hmac hashes canonical(entry) alone. Thus another implementation following the published formula derives different HMACs even for the first zero-linked entry. Rust append/verify share the same helper and cannot detect this specification mismatch; the byte-layout fixture does not pin an independent HMAC result. Establish the intended durable format and migration policy before changing existing log authentication bytes.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [docs/guide-docs/client-server-protocol-spec/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md:349](../../../guide-docs/client-server-protocol-spec/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md); [docs/guide-docs/client-server-protocol-spec/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md:368](../../../guide-docs/client-server-protocol-spec/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/audit_chain.rs:10](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/audit_chain.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/audit_chain.rs:115](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/audit_chain.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/audit_chain.rs:121](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/audit_chain.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/tests/audit_chain_tests.rs:258](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/tests/audit_chain_tests.rs).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-connect P1.14 (P1)](shamir-connect/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-14).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Two rotations can publish different keys with the same version. A finalizer paused after loading an expired overlap can overwrite a newly rotated state. Mirror publication is separate. No live server rotate caller was found; sequential rotation tests cannot discriminate these schedules.

- **Дополнительные counter-evidence / границы:** Snapshot-based stores and a separate version mirror admit lost updates; no live server rotate caller was found. Lost snapshot updates remain, but mirror-matching tickets can still resume; universal rejection is not the mechanism.

<a id="rv-db-b26124d9"></a>

### RV-DB-B26124D9 — Successful repository rename discards declarative schema catalogue fields

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `high`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-db`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-db/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.2](shamir-db/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-2).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-db P1.9 (P1)](shamir-db/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-9).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** rename_repo_as loads the full child record but rewrites it through save_table, which constructs only names, enable_indexes and ResourceMeta. schema/schema_validator_id/schema_version are lost even when every write succeeds. Live info-store bindings travel with the repository; after cold reopen boot_compile_schemas skips the now-schema-less rows, leaving persisted schema bindings without their compiled validator. Applicable writes then fail closed. The registered rename test covers data/indexes, not schema plus cold reopen.

### RV-DB-DEC185C5 — Relaxed catalogue reads can turn corrupt metadata into default-open ACLs

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `high`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-db`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-db/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.3](shamir-db/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-3).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-db P1.8 (P1)](shamir-db/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-8).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** The normal unindexed metadata path enumerates opaque MVCC bodies. A malformed non-map body reaches RecordView rejection; read_streaming records corruption but returns a successful result without that row. SystemStore lookup discards corrupt_records and returns None, and resource_meta maps None to open metadata. With an already-live restricted database and healthy ancestor settings, its non-owner can consequently gain access. This requires malformed bytes admitted by the storage/log layer or catalogue mutation; it is not a claim that checksum-detected backend errors are swallowed or that a default client can manufacture corruption.

<a id="rv-db-bba04407"></a>

### RV-DB-BBA04407 — Namespace Create permits replacement of another owner's private function

**Verdict:** `unverified`; **scoped risk:** `high`; **тип:** unverified contract/safety premise — не safe. **Модули:** `shamir-db`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-db/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.4](shamir-db/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-4).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Прямого явного plan item для собственного root нет; это распределение текущего не-P решения, а не новая исходная маркировка.

- **Нарушенный invariant / проверяемая обязанность:** Не подтверждённая policy premise: какие права нужны для replace существующего Function и можно ли менять owner только с namespace Create.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** create_function_with_opts_as checks FunctionNamespace Create but never existing-function Write/Manage before replace=true; it overwrites both artifact and ResourceMeta with the caller. A User with database visibility and namespace Create can use a one-element nontransactional ForEach body to bypass the server's top-level-only coarse admin gate and replace a known System/other-user-owned function. This establishes cross-owner artifact takeover; automatic secret extraction is not claimed. Preserve explicit replacement/ownership policy and require a target permission if private ownership is intended to protect replacement.

- **Что source-fixed и что остаётся:** Overwrite и owner replacement source-confirmed. Контр-основание: Action Create/Delete описаны как container writes; точного replace contract нет. Verdict пересмотрен с confirmed-open на unverified, не safe.

- **Safe direction (без реализации):** Явно принять/document overwrite + ownership policy для cross-owner/builtin; если target integrity должна охраняться, проверить соответствующее target право до смены артефакта/metadata. Не объявлять target Manage уже обязательным без этого contract.

- **Различающий future oracle (не написан и не запускался):** Матрица namespace Create × target Write/Manage × same/cross owner/builtin через *_as и реальный ForEach wire route; expected verdict задаётся принятой policy, артефакт/owner сравниваются независимо.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/execute/admin_function.rs:38](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/execute/admin_function.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/function_management.rs:140](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/function_management.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/function_management.rs:245](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/function_management.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/db_handler/handler.rs:512](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/db_handler/handler.rs); [crates/shamir-query-types/src/batch/batch_op.rs:577](../../../../crates/shamir-query-types/src/batch/batch_op.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/query_runner.rs:758](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/query_runner.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/query_runner.rs:988](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/query_runner.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/access.rs:590](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/access.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/function_management.rs:274](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/function_management.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/function_management.rs:306](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/function_management.rs); [docs/guide-docs/guide/04-access.md:121](../../../guide-docs/guide/04-access.md); [docs/dev-artifacts/design/root-user-group-dac-posture-550-decision.md:13](../../design/root-user-group-dac-posture-550-decision.md).

- **Изменение verdict / external slice:** Сам overwrite и смена ResourceMeta подтверждены, как и User→ForEach reachability. Однако точной принятой replace-policy, требующей target Write/Manage сверх namespace Create, в прочитанных контрактах нет. Action документирует Create/Delete как запись контейнера; соседние drop/rename проверяют target, но это не спецификация replace. Поэтому security-verdict unverified, не safe и не подтверждённый безусловный privilege bug. Недостающая предпосылка: явная политика overwrite/ownership для существующего Function (включая cross-owner и builtin).

### RV-DB-C57EA68C — DROP/RENAME of databases and repos bypass the #546 create locks — asymmetric serialization axes

### RV-DB-A7A29B02 — Boot path: repo re-attach failure is `warn!` + `continue`, and repo rows for unknown databases are skipped without any log

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-db`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-db/SUMMARY.md · Claim 1.4](shamir-db/SUMMARY.md#review-1-4); [shamir-db/SUMMARY.md · Claim 6.7](shamir-db/SUMMARY.md#review-6-7); [shamir-db/correctness-tdd.md · Claim 4](shamir-db/correctness-tdd.md#review-4); [shamir-db/error-handling-lifecycle.md · Claim 7](shamir-db/error-handling-lifecycle.md#review-7).

<a id="rv-engine-c1a53a7a"></a>

### RV-ENGINE-C1A53A7A — Executable value conditions bypass normal batch depth and pattern collection

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-engine`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-engine/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.11](shamir-engine/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-11).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-engine P1.9 (P1)](shamir-engine/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-9).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** collect_entry_filters selects WHERE/HAVING/delete/update clauses and entry.when, but does not inspect ForEach.over, sub-batch bind values or SELECT function arguments. Those surfaces resolve FilterValue::Cond and compile its condition. A ForEach over value can contain a field-free condition deeper than MAX_FILTER_DEPTH, with both branches yielding a list, and reach compilation without the designated rejection. SELECT function arguments can similarly carry NOT of an invalid Regex and reach False folding despite normal batch authorization/validation. This is not merely a direct-compiler embedding risk. Exact rmp-serde limits exclude the historical arbitrarily deep wire scenario, but do not enforce the engine's smaller cap or pattern grammar. A discriminating oracle requires the same invalid/deep condition to be rejected on each executable surface before body/projection work.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/batch_validate.rs:85](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/batch_validate.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/query_runner.rs:789](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/query_runner.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/query_runner.rs:826](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/query/batch/query_runner.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/query/read/select_projection.rs:131](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/query/read/select_projection.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/query/filter/resolve.rs:415](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/query/filter/resolve.rs); [crates/shamir-query-types/src/batch/for_each_op.rs:23](../../../../crates/shamir-query-types/src/batch/for_each_op.rs); [crates/shamir-query-types/src/batch/planner.rs:320](../../../../crates/shamir-query-types/src/batch/planner.rs).

<a id="rv-engine-2937a1b6"></a>

### RV-ENGINE-2937A1B6 — New validator inverse map is inconsistent with concurrent register/remove

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-engine`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-engine/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.12](shamir-engine/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-12).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1, P2. Исходные пункты: [shamir-engine P1.8 (P1)](shamir-engine/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-8); [shamir-engine P2.14 (P2)](shamir-engine/SUMMARY.md#plan-p2-14).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Register publishes name_to_id and by_id before id_to_name. If another thread removes the ID after by_id publication but before reverse-map publication, remove deletes the artifact, finds no reverse name and cannot remove name_to_id. Register then installs id_to_name and returns success. After both operations, get_by_id is absent while name lookups survive, blocking registration of that name. The production registration/drop facades call these methods without a shared registry admission lock, although occurrence frequency is not measured. Exact scc 3.8.4 makes each individual operation atomic, not this three-map inverse pair. The registered removal test is sequential and binding races exercise a different map. A discriminating seam must pause register after by_id insertion, complete remove, then resume and assert all name/artifact indexes agree. Published dependency source: https://docs.rs/crate/scc/3.8.4/source/src/hash_map.rs.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [Cargo.lock:3123](../../../../Cargo.lock); [crates/shamir-engine/src/validator/registry.rs:83](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/validator/registry.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/validator/registry.rs:90](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/validator/registry.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/validator/registry.rs:150](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/validator/registry.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/validator/tests/registry_tests.rs:76](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/validator/tests/registry_tests.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/validator_management.rs:152](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/validator_management.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/validator_management.rs:343](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/validator_management.rs).

### RV-FUNCLIB-0418C20F — encode's advertised lossless safe-variant roundtrip excludes neither non-finite F64 nor recognized typed map-key prefixes

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-funclib`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-funclib/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.2](shamir-funclib/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-2).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Прямого явного plan item для собственного root нет; это распределение текущего не-P решения, а не новая исходная маркировка.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** encode.rs promises lossless Null/Bool/Int/F64/Str/List/Map roundtrips. Published serde_json 1.0.149 src/ser.rs serializes F64 NaN/infinity as null. Independently, a native/query-produced map key i:x is serialized literally but QueryValue's visitor strips the recognized prefix on decode; incompatible values can make parsing fail. The existing finite-F64/plain-key fixture catches neither. Narrow/document the accepted domain or define a separate faithful conversion contract; do not silently change established prefix semantics. Grouping covers the shared recognized-key-prefix component only. JSON non-finite-number projection to Null is an additional distinct facet of this observation.

### RV-FUNCLIB-775ADABC — Generic canonical APIs do not exclude an interned _prev_hash field despite their unconditional reserved-field documentation

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-funclib`.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** The public generic canonical_bytes/hash documentation says top-level _prev_hash is excluded and discusses InnerValue as supported. Detection compares serialized keys only to the MessagePack string _prev_hash. QueryValue scalar and the located test-local CAS validator use string keys and avoid this facet. Specify the string-key-only contract or provide an explicit interner-aware exclusion API; a single-interner portability note is not sufficient.

<a id="rv-index-216a1b0e"></a>

### RV-INDEX-216A1B0E — Snapshot absorption watermark counts durable delta appends before their graph promotions have completed

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `high`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-index`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-index/SUMMARY.md · Claim 2.1](shamir-index/SUMMARY.md#review-2-1); [shamir-index/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.1](shamir-index/SUMMARY.md#new-1); [shamir-index/concurrency-lockfree.md · Claim 1](shamir-index/concurrency-lockfree.md#review-1).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-index P1.6 (P1)](shamir-index/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-6).

- **Нарушенный invariant / проверяемая обязанность:** Snapshot absorption/prune учитывает graph-applied mutations, не только already appended delta indices.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Commit appends and triggers snapshot before graph promotion. On another worker, the dump can finish while promotion is delayed, record the advanced next_delta_idx, and prune the omitted mutation's chunk. No graph-applied barrier excludes this schedule. An oracle must pause promotion after delta append, complete a snapshot, then restart and verify the mutation.

- **Что source-fixed и что остаётся:** next_delta_idx advancing учитывает append before promotion; multi-map snapshot не quiesced.

- **Safe direction (без реализации):** Координировать coherent graph/sidecar capture с graph-applied barrier/водяным знаком; durable delta append ещё не доказывает graph inclusion.

- **Различающий future oracle (не написан и не запускался):** Pause graph promotion после append, завершить snapshot/prune, restart и искать точный rid/vector; отсутствие missing mutation — независимый expected outcome.

### RV-INDEX-8DB6B1EC — Quantized snapshot load permanently leaks complete temporary dump files

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-index`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-index/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.3](shamir-index/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-3).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Прямого явного plan item для собственного root нет; это распределение текущего не-P решения, а не новая исходная маркировка.

- **Нарушенный invariant / проверяемая обязанность:** Quantized snapshot temp files имеют cleanup owner на всех normal/error lifetime exits.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** The quantized branch writes complete qgraph/qdata files, then Box::leak's their TempDir as well as HnswIo. No owner remains to run TempDir cleanup, including at normal process shutdown; repeated table opens/loads accumulate full dumps in the temporary filesystem. The 'tiny boot-only object' rationale ignores retained file bytes. Exact published hnsw_rs 0.3.4 load_hnsw_with_dist reads owned data and sets datamap_opt=false; that path does not need the files retained for mmap. Loader-borrow lifetime must still be preserved separately. Exact source: https://docs.rs/crate/hnsw_rs/0.3.4/source/src/hnswio.rs.

- **Что source-fixed и что остаётся:** Exact hnsw_rs 0.3.4 loads owned data/datamap_opt=false; TempDir leak сохраняет файлы даже при обычном shutdown.

- **Safe direction (без реализации):** Сохранить необходимый loader borrow lifetime без Box::leak TempDir; hnsw_rs owned non-mmap load позволяет отдельный file cleanup, но не оправдывает dangling loader.

- **Различающий future oracle (не написан и не запускался):** Repeated real quantized loads и их failure exits: все полные qgraph/qdata temp files удаляются при допустимой lifetime границе; graph values остаются доступны.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-index/src/vector/snapshot.rs:983](../../../../crates/shamir-index/src/vector/snapshot.rs); [crates/shamir-index/src/vector/snapshot.rs:1007](../../../../crates/shamir-index/src/vector/snapshot.rs); [crates/shamir-index/src/vector/snapshot.rs:1010](../../../../crates/shamir-index/src/vector/snapshot.rs); [Cargo.lock:1647](../../../../Cargo.lock).

### RV-INDEX-215567C1 — IndexExpr::Mod panics for i64::MIN modulo -1

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-index`.

A discriminating oracle must exercise this exact numeric pair and assert defined Result behavior, not only division-by-zero handling.

### RV-INDEX-0B756318 — index2 `drop_all` sweeps swallow per-key errors, and `VectorBackend::drop_all` leaks the entire `__vec_snap__` keyspace

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-index`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-index/SUMMARY.md · Claim 6.3](shamir-index/SUMMARY.md#review-6-3); [shamir-index/SUMMARY.md · Claim 6.4](shamir-index/SUMMARY.md#review-6-4); [shamir-index/correctness-tdd.md · Claim 6](shamir-index/correctness-tdd.md#review-6); [shamir-index/error-handling-lifecycle.md · Claim 3](shamir-index/error-handling-lifecycle.md#review-3); [shamir-index/performance-hotpath.md · Claim 7](shamir-index/performance-hotpath.md#review-7).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** FTS and functional drops discard every per-key removal error, while scan errors propagate. Vector drop does nothing and binary-prefix recovery misses its persisted string namespace. A scan-failure test cannot detect swallowed removal errors; inject remove failure and inspect retained recovery state.

- **Counter-evidence / границы:** drop_all is a no-op and recovery removes only the compact binary-id prefix, not __vec_snap__<id>. records. Ordinary IDs are monotonic, so resurrection is not a normal DROP consequence. Paged remove_many is suitable only with propagation and preserved tombstone/reader/background-writer ordering.

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped coverage/oracle. **Модули:** `shamir-numa`.

### RV-NUMA-CF3796D2 — `parse_cpulist` expands unbounded ranges -- malformed input can panic/abort the process

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-numa`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md · Claim 1.8](shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md#review-1-8); [shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md · Claim 3.2](shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md#review-3-2); [shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md · Claim 4.2](shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md#review-4-2); [shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md · Claim 5.8](shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md#review-5-8); [shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md · Claim 6.1](shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md#review-6-1); [shamir-numa/api-wire-protocol.md · Claim 8](shamir-numa/api-wire-protocol.md#review-8); [shamir-numa/correctness-tdd.md · Claim 8](shamir-numa/correctness-tdd.md#review-8); [shamir-numa/error-handling-lifecycle.md · Claim 1](shamir-numa/error-handling-lifecycle.md#review-1); [shamir-numa/performance-hotpath.md · Claim 2](shamir-numa/performance-hotpath.md#review-2); [shamir-numa/security-crypto.md · Claim 2](shamir-numa/security-crypto.md#review-2).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-numa P1.3 (P1)](shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-3).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Valid ascending ranges and repeated tokens expand without budgets. The mechanism is present, but malformed-token skipping does not promise bounded handling of every valid range. Current trusted sysfs callers warrant lower severity than an established service-input DoS.

- **Дополнительные counter-evidence / границы:** Neither individual range spans nor cumulative intermediate expansion are bounded. Materialization is unbounded by policy, but current inputs are trusted and large ranges are syntactically valid, not the malformed tokens promised to be skipped. Materialization precedes sort/dedup, with neither span nor cumulative expansion limits. Hostile strings matter only if an embedding caller accepts them; current callers read kernel sysfs. Resource consumption is structural, while exact abort timing is unmeasured.

### RV-NUMA-3378686A — `CPU_SET` without a `CPU_SETSIZE` bound: silent mask truncation (glibc) / out-of-bounds write (musl)

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-numa`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md · Claim 1.4](shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md#review-1-4); [shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md · Claim 3.1](shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md#review-3-1); [shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md · Claim 6.3](shamir-numa/SUMMARY.md#review-6-3); [shamir-numa/correctness-tdd.md · Claim 4](shamir-numa/correctness-tdd.md#review-4); [shamir-numa/error-handling-lifecycle.md · Claim 3](shamir-numa/error-handling-lifecycle.md#review-3); [shamir-numa/security-crypto.md · Claim 1](shamir-numa/security-crypto.md#review-1).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** CPU ID 1024 makes libc 0.2.186 published linux_l4re_shared.rs:1531 index outside its 1024-bit storage. Pinning panics before returning Result. Both Linux GNU and musl use this Rust helper; the C truncation/corruption allegations are false. Reject or safely represent the unsupported domain.

- **Дополнительные counter-evidence / границы:** Exact libc 0.2.186 published linux_l4re_shared.rs:1531 panics through checked indexing at CPU 1024; no production pin caller was found. libc 0.2.186 published linux_l4re_shared.rs:1531 provides checked indexing: CPU ID 1024 panics, rather than C-macro truncation or stack corruption.

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-query-builder-macros`.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** filter!(r#type == 1) passes the single-segment path guard, then emits field ["r#type"] instead of ["type"]. Likewise q!(from r#users) targets "r#users", and raw projection aliases/callee names retain the prefix. proc-macro2 1.0.106 Display delegates to the compiler or prints r# itself; quoted Strings preserve it literally. This is authored-input semantic mislowering, not remote code injection. Discriminating oracle: compare raw and ordinary spellings for a non-keyword identifier, and raw keyword fields against explicit builder string paths. [Raw identifier identity](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/identifiers.html#raw-identifiers).

**Происхождение:** [shamir-query-builder-macros/SUMMARY.md · Claim 2.1](shamir-query-builder-macros/SUMMARY.md#review-2-1); [shamir-query-builder-macros/SUMMARY.md · Claim 4.1](shamir-query-builder-macros/SUMMARY.md#review-4-1); [shamir-query-builder-macros/concurrency-lockfree.md · Claim 1](shamir-query-builder-macros/concurrency-lockfree.md#review-1); [shamir-query-builder-macros/performance-hotpath.md · Claim 1](shamir-query-builder-macros/performance-hotpath.md#review-1).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-query-builder-macros P1.3 (P1)](shamir-query-builder-macros/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-3).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** quote 1.0.45 ToTokens clones the prefix; proc-macro2 1.0.106 unwraps/flushed cloned DeferredTokenStreams. Tagged Rust 1.94.0 concatenation calls push_tree/push_stream; Arc::make_mut and iter().cloned()/extend copy growing top-level prefixes. Hence fixed-size method fragments incur quadratic aggregate prefix work. Nested groups are shared, not universally deep-copied. [Exact backend](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/1.94.0/compiler/rustc_ast/src/tokenstream.rs#L612).

- **Counter-evidence / границы:** This is the same compile-time mechanism, not a concurrency defect or measured hang.

### RV-QUERY-TYPES-959AE4BE — ForEach sibling products are not accumulated into the documented parent operation budget

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-query-types`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.2](shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-2).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-query-types 9 (P1)](shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md#plan-9).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** With parent max_queries=50, two sibling ForEach entries each containing 30 literal elements and one body operation pass: outer count=2, each independently checked product=30. Their combined virtual work is 60, exceeding the promised parent total. This fits ordinary server caps and small payloads; the iteration ceiling and shared deadline do not enforce the stated operation-count composition. Existing local tests cover only one over-budget loop. A two-loop combined-budget assertion would discriminate the mechanism. This differs from already reported client-authoritative limits and recursive per-level fanout.

### RV-QUERY-TYPES-49564B25 — `FilterValue` silently coerces msgpack `uint64 > i64::MAX` to lossy `Float` — asymmetric with the crate's own u64 contract

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-query-types`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md · Claim 4.2](shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md#review-4-2); [shamir-query-types/api-wire-protocol.md · Claim 2](shamir-query-types/api-wire-protocol.md#review-2).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** serde/serde_core 1.0.228 ContentRefDeserializer forwards u64 to the float visitor, whose numeric macro casts it. Int rejects values above i64::MAX. CreateCursor directly decodes ReadQuery; ordinary BatchOp first promotes to Big and re-encodes decimal text. [Serde source](https://docs.rs/crate/serde/1.0.228/source/src/private/de.rs), [primitive visitors](https://docs.rs/crate/serde_core/1.0.228/source/src/de/impls.rs).

### RV-QUERY-TYPES-9CDE03EF — HMAC canonical inputs are not injective (NUL/comma/slash aliasing) and don't cover `cascade`/`if_exists`/`replace` modifiers

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** memory/ownership safety — scoped reachability. **Модули:** `shamir-query-types`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md · Claim 3.5](shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md#review-3-5); [shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md · Claim 4.5](shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md#review-4-5); [shamir-query-types/api-wire-protocol.md · Claim 5](shamir-query-types/api-wire-protocol.md#review-5); [shamir-query-types/security-crypto.md · Claim 5](shamir-query-types/security-crypto.md#review-5).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-query-types 8 (P1)](shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md#plan-8).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Unescaped NUL/slash/CSV components can alias, and cascade/if_exists/replace are absent from the applicable canonical signatures. Cascade changes actual child deletion scope while preserving a tag. Other modifier significance depends on the documented confirmation policy.

- **Дополнительные counter-evidence / границы:** Changing cascade preserves the tag and changes actual deletion scope. dst_path is omitted too, but current migration is opt-in, in-memory-only and does not use it to select storage. Migration dst_path is also absent but only retained as state: current migration is disabled by default, supports in_memory only and does not route storage through dst_path.

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-query-types`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md · Claim 1.2](shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md#review-1-2); [shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md · Claim 4.4](shamir-query-types/SUMMARY.md#review-4-4); [shamir-query-types/api-wire-protocol.md · Claim 4](shamir-query-types/api-wire-protocol.md#review-4); [shamir-query-types/correctness-tdd.md · Claim 2](shamir-query-types/correctness-tdd.md#review-2).

### RV-QUERY-TYPES-1EC04E32 — `BatchOp::deserialize` — triple codec round-trip + key clones + linear dispatch chain per op

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** structural cost — без измерений. **Модули:** `shamir-query-types`.

### RV-SDK-MACROS-966AA3AD — Raw function identifiers panic during helper-name construction

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-sdk-macros`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-sdk-macros/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.1](shamir-sdk-macros/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-1).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-sdk-macros P1.4 (P1)](shamir-sdk-macros/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-4).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** A valid annotated async function named r#type reaches format("__shamir_impl_{}", fn_name), producing __shamir_impl_r#type, which is not an identifier. proc-macro2 1.0.106 preserves the raw prefix in Display and rejects invalid characters in Ident::new; published src/fallback.rs:805/850/910 and compiler delegation in src/wrapper.rs:674 confirm the mechanism: https://docs.rs/crate/proc-macro2/1.0.106/source/src/fallback.rs. The compiler-facing constructor contract also requires a valid identifier: https://doc.rust-lang.org/proc_macro/struct.Ident.html. All four macros use this construction. A compile-pass raw-name fixture would discriminate a repair; no reproduction was executed.

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** memory/ownership safety — scoped reachability. **Модули:** `shamir-sdk-macros`.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** All four safe public exports construct slices from caller-supplied integers. Negative len violates slice extent requirements; a safe Rust call with ptr=0,len=0 also violates non-null requirements. Ordinary WASM host calls use checked lengths and allocated ranges. ### RV-SDK-B5ACD67D — No tests for `http.rs` / `params.rs` / `db.rs` mapping / `__rt` ABI helpers (TDD protocol not followed for most of the crate)

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped coverage/oracle. **Модули:** `shamir-sdk`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md · Claim 1.1](shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md#review-1-1); [shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md · Claim 3.9](shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md#review-3-9); [shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md · Claim 6.4](shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md#review-6-4); [shamir-sdk/correctness-tdd.md · Claim 1](shamir-sdk/correctness-tdd.md#review-1); [shamir-sdk/error-handling-lifecycle.md · Claim 5](shamir-sdk/error-handling-lifecycle.md#review-5); [shamir-sdk/security-crypto.md · Claim 10](shamir-sdk/security-crypto.md#review-10).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Registered SDK tests cover ordinary encoding, valid-map decoding, i64/str success, and Ready execution, but not malformed HTTP, getter failures, packing, or DB error mappings. Removing Str support from bytes would escape these local assertions.

### RV-SDK-152055F3 — Guest get documentation says primary-key lookup while the gateway intentionally accepts an empty match-all key

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `low`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-sdk`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md · Claim 5.2](shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md#review-5-2); [shamir-sdk/api-wire-protocol.md · Claim 2](shamir-sdk/api-wire-protocol.md#review-2).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-sdk P1.10 (P1)](shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-10).

- **Нарушенный invariant / проверяемая обязанность:** Public Table documentation должна честно описывать filtered single-match/empty-key convention, не обещать безусловный stable primary-key lookup.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Table::get(empty Map) строит no filter и берёт records.first. db_gateway.rs:55–62 explicitly documents empty map as match-all: это intentional gateway convention. SDK db.rs:63 и :72–78 рекламирует primary-key fields и даже Ok(None) при Option signature. Неверный consumer assumption может выбрать произвольную first match; обязательного nonempty-key rejection current contract не устанавливает.

- **Counter-evidence / границы:** Непустой Map primary fields и scalar id convention задокументированы; actor execute_as DAC всё ещё применяется. Empty conjunction match-all прямо описан в helper. Это docs/API clarity obligation, не ACL bypass и не доказательство, что любой get обязан стать strict ID API.

- **Что source-fixed и что остаётся:** Текущего doc alignment не найдено; намеренный match-all transition не выдан за случайный runtime bug.

- **Safe direction (без реализации):** Минимальное совместимое решение — уточнить public documentation accepted filtering/empty/single-first semantics и действительный Option/error channel. Strict-primary-key/empty rejection вводить только как отдельный явно выбранный contract, не молчаливый validation redesign.

- **Различающий future oracle (не написан и не запускался):** Через настоящую Table/get границу независимо seed две rows; непустой key/scalar id возвращает нужную matching row, empty key соответствует документированной match-all first-match policy. Проверить реальные actor denials. Ровно выбранный docs/API контракт должен различаться от исходной безусловной primary-key prose; deterministic first RID не требовать без ORDER BY гарантии.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_gateway.rs:65](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_gateway.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_gateway.rs:146](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_gateway.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_gateway.rs:155](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_gateway.rs); [crates/shamir-sdk/src/db.rs:63](../../../../crates/shamir-sdk/src/db.rs); [crates/shamir-sdk/src/db.rs:74](../../../../crates/shamir-sdk/src/db.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_gateway.rs:55](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_gateway.rs).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Исходные пункты: [shamir-sdk P1.5 (P1)](shamir-sdk/SUMMARY.md#plan-p1-5).

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Published rmp-serde-1.3.1.crate src/decode.rs gives SeqAccess/MapAccess the declared u32 collection count as size_hint. SDK visitors feed it directly to Vec::with_capacity before reading the first element. Five-byte Array32/Map32 headers declaring u32::MAX therefore request enormous/capacity-overflow allocations before truncation can return a codec error. The host visitor already clamps preallocation, but the SDK does not. Reachability is public external Value decoding, including a guest manually decoding HTTP Bin bodies; ordinary normalized host replies do not supply this malformed header. No exhaustion experiment or exact threshold was measured.

<a id="rv-server-fb3ec046"></a>

### RV-SERVER-FB3EC046 — Production response-budget guard is destroyed before writer handoff

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `high`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-server`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-server/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.2](shamir-server/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-2).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Прямого явного plan item для собственного root нет; это распределение текущего не-P решения, а не новая исходная маркировка.

- **Нарушенный invariant / проверяемая обязанность:** Response reservation удерживается пока bytes в channel/socket writer живы, не только во время dispatch polling.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** request_loop awaits run_with_guard_slot(dispatch_request_view(...)), then calls take_stashed_guard outside that scope. Tokio 1.49.0 TaskLocalFuture restores the previous task-local value after each poll and drops its owned slot when the scoped future ends; consequently the stashed guard drops before WriterMsg creation and try_with returns no guard. Responses waiting in the channel/socket therefore escape the promised global write-residency budget even with the default finite cap. Existing registered helpers take the guard inside the scope, so they exercise a different ownership seam. Exact source: https://docs.rs/crate/tokio/1.49.0/source/src/task/task_local.rs. The discriminating oracle must use the real request loop with a blocked writer, verify bytes remain reserved, then verify release on write completion/error. Retrieve ownership inside the scope or return it explicitly with dispatch output; retain writer-side release semantics.

- **Что source-fixed и что остаётся:** CAS admission/Drop локально корректны. Tokio 1.49 TaskLocalFuture восстанавливает slot при poll и уничтожает owned slot при завершении; take снаружи не получает guard.

- **Safe direction (без реализации):** Вернуть guard вместе с dispatch output либо извлечь внутри task-local scope и передать WriterMsg; оставить release на completion/error write.

- **Различающий future oracle (не написан и не запускался):** Настоящий request_loop с blocked writer: global reserved bytes остаются charged после dispatch и handoff, освобождаются только при completion/error. Helper take внутри scope — иной seam.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-server/src/connection/request_loop.rs:340](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/connection/request_loop.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/connection/request_loop.rs:348](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/connection/request_loop.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/byte_budget.rs:339](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/byte_budget.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/byte_budget.rs:372](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/byte_budget.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/db_handler/handler.rs:660](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/db_handler/handler.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/db_handler/tests/byte_budget_exhaustion_tests.rs:126](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/db_handler/tests/byte_budget_exhaustion_tests.rs); [Cargo.lock:4195](../../../../Cargo.lock).

<a id="rv-server-fe6b4c98"></a>

### RV-SERVER-FE6B4C98 — Graceful shutdown flushes without quiescing already accepted connection tasks

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-server`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-server/SUMMARY.md · Observation NEW.4](shamir-server/SUMMARY.md#observation-new-4).

**P provenance:** Минимальный исходный P среди явно связанных plan items/связанных NEW: P1. Прямого явного plan item для собственного root нет; это распределение текущего не-P решения, а не новая исходная маркировка.

- **Нарушенный invariant / проверяемая обязанность:** Final shutdown flush выполняется после quiescence accepted writes и ownership ресурсов/instance lock завершено.

- **Точный trigger, consequence и reachability:** Accept loops spawn detached connection tasks that retain ConnectionContext and database/store owners but receive no root shutdown token. ServerHandle cancels and joins accept loops, then stops maintenance and performs flush_all, while existing authenticated connections can still dispatch writes. Thus the 'no new writes can arrive' prerequisite is false; on a surviving library runtime, sessions/resources can outlive shutdown and the instance lock, and process-exit ordering can leave writes occurring after the intended final flush. No exact loss window or observed corruption is claimed. runtime_serve's test opens no active connection, so it cannot catch this. A discriminating test must retain an authenticated connection across shutdown and verify admission/drain and flush ordering; do not simply abort arbitrary in-progress commits without defining their cancellation/durability semantics.

- **Что source-fixed и что остаётся:** Accept loops cancel/join, maintenance останавливается; detached connections не получают root token.

- **Safe direction (без реализации):** Отслеживать accepted connection/tasks, прекратить admission, определить drain/cancel outcomes уже принятых commits, затем flush и release lock. Abort произвольного commit без outcomes небезопасен.

- **Различающий future oracle (не написан и не запускался):** Живая authenticated connection переживает начало shutdown; запрещён новый dispatch после quiescence, все принятые outcomes settled до final flush, после возврата не остаётся session work. Тест без connection недостаточен.

- **Current file:line evidence:** [crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_launcher.rs:1137](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_launcher.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_launcher.rs:1165](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_launcher.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/connection/connection_context.rs:30](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/connection/connection_context.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_handle.rs:104](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_handle.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_handle.rs:129](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_handle.rs); [crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_management.rs:632](../../../../crates/shamir-db/src/shamir_db/shamir_db/db_management.rs); [crates/shamir-server/tests/runtime_serve.rs:64](../../../../crates/shamir-server/tests/runtime_serve.rs).

### RV-SERVER-6CA31DF8 — `close_all()` / `attach_handle()` race can leak a bridge task past connection teardown

**Verdict:** `confirmed-open`; **scoped risk:** `medium`; **тип:** scoped correctness/lifecycle/API. **Модули:** `shamir-server`.

**Происхождение:** [shamir-server/SUMMARY.md · Claim 1.3](shamir-server/SUMMARY.md#review-1-3); [shamir-server/correctness-tdd.md · Claim 3](shamir-server/correctness-tdd.md#review-3); [shamir-server/error-handling-lifecycle.md · Claim Notes/request-loop teardown](shamir-server/error-handling-lifecycle.md#review-notes-request-loop-teardown).
